config.name: DRV_CFG_OVERLAY_DIR_NODES_NUM
config.brief: Number of directory nodes pre-allocated in the pool.

field.name: index
field.brief: Next directory entry to be read.

class.name: vfs_overlay_driver
class.brief: File system overlay with caller-managed backing file systems.
class.details: The overlaid and registered file systems are borrowed. Unregistering a file system or disposing the overlay does not dispose them. The caller must keep them alive while accessible through an overlay or while their nodes or operations remain active. Routing borrows read-only absolute paths and does not allocate path buffers. Backing prefixes are provided by the root driver.

objinit.param: Pointer to a file system to be overlaid or @p NULL.

method.name: ovldrvRegisterDriver
method.brief: Registers a VFS file system as an overlay.
method.note: The file system remains owned by the caller. It must remain alive while registered and until all its nodes and operations have finished. The name string must remain valid while registered.
method.param: Pointer to the caller-owned file system to be registered.
Name for the new overlay directory, must be alphanumeric.

method.name: ovldrvUnregisterDriver
method.note: Only the mapping is removed. The file system and its existing nodes are not disposed. Its lifetime remains the caller's responsibility.
method.param: Name of the overlay directory to be unregistered.

struct.name: vfs_overlay_driver_static_struct
struct.brief: Structure representing the global state of @p vfs_overlay_driver_c.

function.name: __ovldrv_match
function.brief: Matches a registered mount without changing the path.
function.note: The input points just after the initial separator. On success it advances to the remaining separator or string terminator. This function requires thread context.
function.param: Pointer to the matched file system pointer, set on success.

function.name: __ovldrv_open_root
function.brief: Opens a merged root using an already prepared backing path.
function.note: A missing backing directory leaves an empty backing view, as for an overlay without a backing FS. The path is borrowed until return. This function requires thread context.
function.param: Normalized absolute path of the backing directory.
Pointer to the opened directory node pointer.
